data.one_liner: A datetime picker package with option for a single datetime picker or a datetime range picker.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable single date/time pickers and date/time range pickers as dialogs or standalone widgets. It supports 12/24 hour modes, seconds, intervals, and selectable day predicates.
use_when: You need to allow users to select both a date and a time in your Flutter app.
You need a range picker for start and end date-times.
You want customizable date/time picker dialogs or embedded widgets.
avoid_when: You only need standard platform-native date or time pickers without custom ranges or combined widgets.
strengths: Supports both single and range datetime picking.
Highly customizable including themes, constraints, transitions, and intervals.
Can be used as a dialog or directly as a widget.
weaknesses: Adds heavy external dependencies like flutter_bloc and rxdart for a date picker widget.
